entries.title: Psalms 36:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.>> The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, [that there is] no fear of God before his eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 36:2
segments: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful. {until...: Heb. to find his iniquity to hate}

words.text: . {until...: Heb. to find his iniquity to hate}

entries.title: Psalms 36:3
segments: The words of his mouth [are] iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, [and] to do good.

entries.title: Psalms 36:4
segments: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way [that is] not good; he abhorreth not evil. {mischief: or, vanity}

entries.title: Psalms 36:5
segments: ¶Thy mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; [and] thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 36:6
segments: Thy righteousness [is] like the great mountains; thy judgments [are] a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast. {the...: Heb. the mountains of God}

entries.title: Psalms 36:7
segments: How excellent [is] thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings. {excellent: Heb. precious}

entries.title: Psalms 36:8
segments: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures. {abundantly...: Heb. watered}

words.text: ; and thou shalt make them drink

entries.title: Psalms 36:9
segments: For with thee [is] the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

entries.title: Psalms 36:10
segments: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart. {continue: Heb. draw out at length}

entries.title: Psalms 36:11
segments: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

words.text: against me, and let not the hand

entries.title: Psalms 36:12
segments: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
